sentences.text:
Office Notes,
 reports, orders or  proceedings or No Date COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS  directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  C-528 No. 1959 of 2025  Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Rajat Mittal, learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. Mr. Dharmendra Barthwal, learned counsel for respondent no. 2.
4.

The present C-528 application has been filed to quash/set-aside the chargesheet dated 15.11.2010 as well as cognizance/summoning order dated 21.02.2011 passed against the applicant by the court of Judicial Magistrate, Vikasnagar in Criminal Case No. 279 of 2011 and the entire proceedings arising out from it.

5. As per the averments of the FIR, the applicant applied for Kisan Credit Card and a loan of Rs.
50,000/- was granted to him by the Bank.
But, later on, when the audit of the bank was going on, it was found that the applicant have supplied a forged khatauni in his name to support his loan application.
Subsequently, an FIR was lodged against the applicant under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 IPC.
6. Learned counsel for the respondents pray for and are granted three weeks' time to file counter-affidavit in the matter.

7. Having heard the submission, this Court is of the view that this matter definitely requires deliberation.
8.
Issue notice to respondent no. 2, returnable within four weeks.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Till then, the proceedings of the learned court below shall remain in abeyance.
(Alok Mahra J.) 07.11.2025 Ujjwal C528/1959/2025 on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177258680/
